result.reason: The redline properly makes the cap mutual and sets it at the greater of trailing-12-month amounts and USD 1,000,000 with limited changes. However, the supplied operative language does not define “Excluded Claims,” exclude indirect/consequential damages, or state that Customer payment obligations are not damages. The margin comment cannot establish the asserted carve-outs. Also, “all amounts” is broader than “fees” and may include non-fee payments, while “under this Agreement and all Order Forms” is potentially duplicative.
